Saudi Arabia Faces Dual Conflict with Iran and Houthis

Saudi Arabia is engaged in a dual conflict, facing aggression from Iran and attacks by the Houthis. Despite a high defense budget, Saudi Arabia has struggled to effectively counter the Houthi threat, with recent airport attacks exposing vulnerabilities. The conflict's impact is also being felt in Africa.
